objective: 实现 Container Runtime V2 第一 Apply 切片：不可变核心模型与纯 prepare/reduce seam，并用确定性测试和架构 Guard 证明其无行为、authority 和第二套 current truth 泄漏

semantic_brief.summary: Buyer：r5、Z4、unresolved child first frame 和 multi-entry/return 压力要求先能表达当前物理 working Container 与一次真实 transition occurrence。只实现纯模型/Reducer，不接 Agent；结果必须可证明 working node 可先于身份信任存在且 Graph 不获得 planner/action authority。
core_points: CurrentContainer是唯一当前物理working-location投影，pending execution obligation不复制进去
TransitionOccurrence不同于Action expectation、Graph relation和identity trust
所有核心state采用不可变替换；stale/invalid输入为零commit
本切片不修改Agent、Container、DriverHost、Semantic provider或现有行为

change_principles: 先搜索scope.read_hints及全仓同职责symbol；REUSE > EXTEND > REFACTOR > CREATE，不得创建第二套Graph/Current/Transition abstraction
实现仅覆盖OpenSpec tasks 2.1至2.5；不得顺手开始Graph service、Agent集成、Fast/Slow、LocalModel或completeness工作
核心references必须Run-local、opaque、非semantic identity truth；working node允许identity candidate为空
TransitionOccurrence必须immutable且与Graph relation分离；completed只表示物理occurrence充分观察，不表示identity trusted或normal relation
Graph snapshot只含nodes、relations、append-only occurrence/evidence；不得暴露route、next-action、authorize、recover、complete、canonical parent或Current属性
Reducer必须pure、deterministic、无I/O/no-await；validate-before-next-state，stale/invalid时返回显式rejection且原state引用/值不变
同一Destination node可由Desktop和Search两个独立Source/Trigger relation到达；TriggerText不得作为永久relation identity
off-path/transient/abnormal occurrence可以保留但未显式eligible时不得创建normal reusable relation
NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION必须写入生产类型XML doc或测试证据：现有Container要求已知SemanticPageName，旧ContainerTransition混合execution disposition，RunExecutionGraph只属DriverHost read model
你不是仓库唯一执行者；不得回退或覆盖他人/用户修改，发现scope文件已有并发编辑时停止上报Leader
acceptance: production contract集中在一个新Model文件，tests集中在两个授权文件；git diff无scope.write之外Worker新增修改
单元测试覆盖INITIALIZED working node且semantic identity为空、transition completed但identity untrusted、r5-style CurrentContainer先进到fresh node且pending obligation不进入V2 state
单元测试覆盖Desktop和Search到同一Settings NodeRef形成两个RelationRef/EntryContext，equal trigger text不自动merge
单元测试覆盖off-path occurrence append但normal relation不增加、repeated occurrences可支持一个显式relation、fresh evidence revision单调
单元测试覆盖stale revision、unknown ref、source/destination/entry不一致、duplicate ref冲突均显式reject且previous aggregate state不变

架构Guard证明生产模型无Agent/Container/Environment/DriverHost/Planning/Recovery依赖，无Action/Goal/Plan/Route/Next/Authorize/Recover/Complete API，无Parent/CanonicalParent、Current Graph slot、mutable latest transition/trust/checkpoint
架构Guard或反射测试证明所有公开集合为immutable/read-only value，Reducer为static/pure surface且无Task/async/provider callback/I/O参数
targeted tests通过，dotnet build src/UniClaw.Runtime/UniClaw.Runtime.csproj通过，旧ContainerTransition focused tests保持通过，git diff --check通过
WorkResult逐个列出NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION、实际修改文件、测试命令/结果、未解决风险，并明确AuthorityDelta=NONE、BehaviorDelta=NONE、NET_NEW_MUTABLE_TRUTH=0
forbidden: 禁止修改OpenSpec、docs、WorkItem、tasks checkbox或scope.write之外任何文件
禁止把architecture hypothesis实现成production action/current/completion authority
禁止新增IContainerGraphReader/IContainerGraphRecorder、Fast/Slow interface；这些属于后续tasks 3和6/7，本WorkItem只做immutable core/reducer
禁止用semantic identity、TriggerText、bounds、ordinal、StableKey或Graph relation作为Node/Relation永久identity或action authority
禁止改变现有测试断言、放宽fail-closed或删除失败case来获得GREEN
escalation: 若最小模型无法同时满足working-unproven node与现有Container契约而必须修改Container，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_NEXT_WORKITEM，不扩scope
若需要新增interface/service/mutable owner才能实现Reducer，停止并给出REUSE/EXTEND/REFACTOR/CREATE比较与NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION候选
若spec无法决定relation eligibility、Node binding/fold或revision规则，返回BLOCKED_FOR_SPEC并列出最小歧义；不得自行发明ontology
若scope文件存在不明并发修改或测试失败指向scope外实现，保留现场并返回Expected/Observed/Gap/FirstDivergence/Owner
若任何设计会改变Runtime authority、Agent/Driver/Environment边界、Goal/Recovery/completion语义或引入长期依赖，立即停止并返回REQUIRED_HUMAN_GATE
